quests.name: First steps
quests.description: Tap the dark ground to clear it. Find four stands of forest — you will want the timber.

quests.name: Forestry
quests.description: Nothing here can be worked by hand yet. Research Forestry — it opens the woods and the berry bushes both.

quests.name: Timber!
quests.description: Now tap the trees beside your Townhall. Twenty-five Wood buys a roof and a field.

quests.name: A roof
quests.description: Build a House. Somebody has to live here.

quests.name: Rations
quests.description: Tap the berry bush west of your Townhall for Food. Villagers eat.

quests.name: First villager
quests.description: Train your first villager — your new House has room for two.

quests.name: Tax day
quests.description: Your villager pays rent. Tap the House to hurry it along — 30 Gold.

quests.name: Explorer
quests.description: Push the fog back further. The land is worth knowing.

quests.name: Fields
quests.description: Research Agriculture: crop plots you can tap for Food.

quests.name: First plot
quests.description: Build two crop plots on open grass.

quests.name: By hand
quests.description: Tap the plots for Food. Doing this forever is not the plan.

quests.name: Lumber
quests.description: Chop enough Wood by hand to raise a Farm.

quests.name: Tillage
quests.description: Research Farming: a Farm that works the plots for you.

quests.name: Farmhand
quests.description: Build a Farm beside your plot.

quests.name: Put them to work
quests.description: Assign a villager to the Farm. Now it harvests without you.

quests.name: Growing town
quests.description: Build a second House. The Wood is starting to add up.

quests.name: Neighbors
quests.description: Train another villager — the new House has the room.

quests.name: A proper capital
quests.description: Your Townhall is full. Upgrade it for room to build.

quests.name: Saw teeth
quests.description: Research Saws. Hand-chopping has taken you as far as it goes.

quests.name: The Sawmill
quests.description: Build a Sawmill within reach of the forest.

quests.name: Crewed
quests.description: Put three villagers to work — two of them on the Sawmill.

quests.name: Levies
quests.description: Research Taxes. A settled town pays its hall a little more.

quests.name: Sawpits
quests.description: Research Sawpits. Every swing at a tree brings back a little more.

quests.name: Regrowth
quests.description: Research Reforesting. The stumps come back sooner.

quests.name: Further afield
quests.description: The map is bigger than your fields. Keep clearing it.

quests.name: Armed men
quests.description: There is a barrow west of your fields, and it is not empty. Research Warriors.

quests.name: Mustered
quests.description: Build a Barracks. You will need Stone — there is rock to the east.

quests.name: First soldier
quests.description: Train your first soldier.

quests.name: A hero answers
quests.description: Summon at the banner. The first call is free.

quests.name: A company
quests.description: Train twenty-four soldiers. One is a guard; a company is what takes a gate.

quests.name: Drive them out
quests.description: Orcs hold the mouth of the Hollow Barrow, and they are counting down. Clear the gate.

quests.name: Old stones
quests.description: Claim the shrine east of the Townhall. It will hold your magic.

quests.name: Attunement
quests.description: Consecrate a Sanctum. The stones you claimed hum with something the city can hold.

quests.name: Mapmakers
quests.description: Reveal 20 more cells — a map is drawn by walking it.

quests.name: Surveyors
quests.description: Reveal 25 more — the far rings are dearer, and worth it.

quests.name: Into the highlands
quests.description: Research Scaling Tools to climb the mountains.

quests.name: Put to sea
quests.description: Research Sailing to cross open water.

quests.name: Into the dark
quests.description: Send a party into the Hollow Barrow and survive one depth.

quests.name: Stoneworks
quests.description: Build a Quarry. Tapping rock by hand has served its purpose.

quests.name: More room
quests.description: Research Urban Planning to build Houses taller.

quests.name: Second story
quests.description: Upgrade a House to level 2.

quests.name: Full house
quests.description: Grow to eight villagers.

quests.name: The iron road
quests.description: Iron lies in the northern ridge. Bring back ten.

quests.name: The architect
quests.description: Set the city's clerks to work. With them the Townhall may stand a level higher.

quests.name: Deep seams
quests.description: The peaks give up ordinary stone. Research Mining and your quarrymen bring the iron out of them too.

quests.name: A grand capital
quests.description: Raise the Townhall to level 3.

quests.name: A place for magic
quests.description: Build the Sanctum.

quests.name: A warband
quests.description: Sixty soldiers under arms. The deeper ruins are fought by companies.

quests.name: The Barrow’s Prize
quests.description: Clear the Hollow Barrow to its floor.

quests.name: Worn well
quests.description: Attune an artifact to your kingdom.

quests.name: Leylines
quests.description: Claim four of the old places.

quests.name: Deeper still
quests.description: Reach depth five in any ruin.

quests.name: The Reliquary
quests.description: Hold three artifacts at once.
